items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Mr. Harvey J. Sims as the source of the idea to form a band, but the interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not speak about a personal relationship with him in this excerpt.

ctx.x: Well, how did you get to play trumpet. I mean how did that come about?
Well, that came about through ... respect for kids have to have something to do and he thought the ideas of Mr. Harvey J. Sims.
Is that two m's in Sims?
